system.description: Your delirium has infected not only your senses but your ability to communicate. During moments of stress, or whenever the Narrator deems it appropriate (such as after badly losing a Social challenge or entering frenzy), you can only speak in tongues; no matter how hard you try, everything comes out as gibberish. A Willpower Trait can be spent to force out a single coherent sentence, but after that you can only babble for the rest of the scene.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
